quarterly_data.quarter: Montage Technology results briefing Q&A: H1 2026 (09-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 results briefing: the company said its CXL 3.2 MXC chip, in trial production since July and designed into next-generation CXL products of major module makers including Samsung and SK Hynix, is currently in validation testing and not yet in volume production. General manager Stephen Kuong-Io Tai said some TPU and GPU products are starting to support CXL for large-capacity memory expansion, and that CXL can reuse DDR4 and cut memory-expansion cost as DRAM prices rise. Chairman Yang Chonghe said the company is a JEDEC board member and holds roles in PCI-SIG, the CXL consortium and the UALink consortium.
